text: You voted on the fourth of November. Here's how that vote reaches your rates bill.
asr: You voted on the 4th of November. Here's how that vote reaches your rates bill.

text: First, the results. The IEC has seven days to declare them.
Then the new council meets and elects a mayor. Where no party has more than half the seats, that takes a coalition deal.
From the council, the lines run to your house. Property rates. Water. Refuse. Electricity.
Electricity is different. The regulator, NERSA, must approve every increase.
Around the end of March, the mayor tables a draft budget, and residents can comment.
Council must approve it before the first of July, with the new tariffs.
asr: Council must approve it before the 1st of July, with the new tariffs.

text: On the first of July twenty twenty-seven, the new rates reach your bill. Next stop: twenty thirty-one.
asr: On the 1st of July 2027, the new rates reach your bill. Next stop, 2031.

text: Mmzahnsee Money Matters. Know who sets your rates.
asr: Mzansi Money Matters. Know who sets your rates.
